blocks.tamil_translation: as little." Hazrat Utbah ibn Abd (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: خَصْلَتَانِ مَنْ كَانَتَا فِيهِ كَتَبَهُ اللهُ شَاكِرًا صَابِرًا، وَمَنْ لَمْ تَكُونَا فِيهِ لَمْ يَكْتُبْهُ اللهُ شَاكِرًا وَلَا صَابِرًا: مَنْ نَظَرَ فِي دِينِهِ إِلَي مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَهُ فَاقْتَدَي بِهِ وَمَنْ نَظَرَ فِي دُنْيَاهُ إِلَي مَنْ هُوَ دُونَهُ فَحَمِدَ اللهَ عَلَي مَا فَضَّلَهُ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ كَتَبَهُ اللهُ شَاكِرًا وَصَابِرًا، وَمَنْ نَظَرَ فِي دِينِهِ إِلَي مَنْ هُوَ دُونَهُ وَنَظَرَ فِي دُنْيَاهُ إِلَي مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَهُ فَأَسِفَ عَلَي مَا فَاتَهُ مِنْهُ لَمْ يَكْتُبْهُ اللهُ شَاكِرًا وَلَا صَابِرًا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال هذا حديث حسن غريب باب انظروا الي من هو اسفل منكم رقم:٢٥١٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that the beloved Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever has two qualities, Allah will include him among the grateful and the patient. Whoever does not have these two qualities, Allah will not count him among the grateful and the patient. The person who, in matters of Deen, looks at the one above him and follows him, and who, in worldly matters, looks at those in a lower position than himself and, considering that (Allah, out of His grace alone) has placed him in a better position than them, also gives thanks to Him — Allah writes him among the grateful and the patient. The person who, in matters of Deen, looks at one lower than himself and, in worldly matters, looks at those above him and grieves that he has received little of the world — Allah will count him neither among the patient nor among the grateful."
